summary: Pacific Booker Minerals Inc. filed a directors' circular (Form 6-K) recommending rejection of an unsolicited hostile bid by American Eagle Gold Corp. The bid offers 1.41 American Eagle shares per Pacific Booker share. The Board, advised by the Special Committee and financial/legal advisors, unanimously deems the bid inadequate and recommends shareholders take no action. No premium is stated; the target's Morrison Project is cited as undervalued. Shareholders who tendered can withdraw. The bid expires July 29, 2026. Watch for a superior offer or alternative value-maximizing transactions; risk-arb highlights the strategic contest and potential white knight.
